title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
description: State-changing requests are not protected against forgery, allowing an attacker to craft a page that causes an authenticated victim's browser to submit unwanted actions to the application. The action executes with the victim's privileges without their intent.
businessImpact: Moderate --- an attacker can induce authenticated users to perform unwanted actions such as changing settings or data, with greater impact for administrative users.
remediation:
- Use anti-CSRF tokens (synchronizer token pattern) for all state-changing requests.
- Set SameSite=Lax or Strict on session cookies.
- Require re-authentication or verification for sensitive actions.
- Validate the Origin/Referer header for sensitive endpoints.
